按我们刚才确认的图继续做：还在排队的任务，轮到它开始准备时检查当时的权限；检查时已撤销共享就取消。若开始前已恢复共享，这个尚未取消的任务可以继续。已经开始准备的可以完成、领取；已经取消的不会自动恢复，需重新申请。其他同事的权限、上传者自己的下载和公告板照旧。
Coordination: this change also adopts the already-identified deterministic provider tooling upgrade from source-index-final-skills/vibelens to ordered-evidence-skills/vibelens. Use the retained accepted provider only for this strict begin; all implementation, inspect, generation and verification use the new immutable provider.
scope: Only strict baseline begin from the verified accepted state; not implementation verification
